statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
Diagnosis code I48.0 (paroxysmal atrial fibrillation) is documented
Diagnosis code I34.0 (nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency) is documented
Diagnosis code I49.5 (sick sinus syndrome) is documented
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
